learning.learning_goal: Understand that difference names how many items are left after two groups are paired.
learning.big_idea: Pair the groups and count what is left in the larger group. That number is called the difference.

screens.label: Lesson 003
screens.title: Difference
screens.body: Pair one item from each group. Count the items left in the larger group. The number left is called the difference.

screens.label: Misconception
screens.title: Is either amount the difference?
screens.prompt: One team scored 18 points and another scored 11. What is the difference?

choices.text: 18, because it is the larger score
7, because 7 points are left after pairing 11 with 11
choices.feedback: Pair 11 points from each score. Seven points from the score of 18 are left. The difference is 7.

hints: Pair 11 points from the score of 11 with 11 points from the score of 18.
Seven points from the larger score are left without partners. That number is the difference.

visual.message: Pair each bottom block with one top block. Then count the top blocks left without partners.

screens.label: Discover
screens.title: What does the highlighted part represent?

visual.message: After 8 pairs are made, 5 top blocks are left. The number left is called the difference.

choices.feedback: Correct. Five top blocks are left after pairing, so the difference between 13 and 8 is 5.

hints: Match one block in the top row with one in the bottom row.
Focus on the blocks without a partner.
Count the 5 blocks without partners. That number is the difference.

screens.label: Language
screens.title: Several questions ask for a difference.

visual.message: Each question asks you to pair the groups and count what is left.

screens.phraseMeaning: Pair the groups. Count what is left.
screens.guidance: “In all” asks you to join the groups. “Difference,” “how many more,” and “how many fewer” ask how far apart the groups are. Pairing shows that distance.

screens.label: Remember
screens.title: Difference is what is left after pairing.
screens.body: The difference is not either starting number. It is the number left after the smaller group is paired with part of the larger group.

screens.label: Symbol
screens.title: Which equation finds the difference?

visual.message: Start with 13 top blocks. Eight receive partners. Which number sentence counts the top blocks left?

choices.feedback: Correct. Subtract the 8 paired blocks from the 13 top blocks. Five blocks are left, so the difference is 5.

hints: Start with the 13 blocks in the larger row. Eight receive partners.

visual.message: Five blocks are unmatched, so the difference is 5.

screens.label: Guided practice
screens.title: Measure the difference.

visual.message: Match five blocks in each row. The unmatched part is the difference.

choices.feedback: Seven blocks are unmatched, so the difference is 7.

hints: Pair each of the 5 bottom blocks with one top block.
Seven top blocks are left. You can calculate 12 − 5 = 7.

screens.label: Independent practice
screens.title: Find the difference without the model.
screens.prompt: What is the difference between 20 and 13?
hints: Imagine 20 marks in one row and 13 in another. Pair 13 marks from each row.
Seven marks are left in the longer row. You can calculate 20 − 13 = 7.

screens.label: Recall
screens.title: Complete the memory rule.
screens.prompt: The difference between two amounts is...

choices.text: the number left after the groups are paired
choices.feedback: Correct. Pair one item from each group. The items left in the larger group show the difference.

hints: Pair one item from each group until the smaller group runs out.
Count the items left in the larger group. That count is the difference.

screens.label: Transfer
screens.title: Use difference in a new setting.
screens.prompt: The high temperature was 72°F and the low was 64°F. What was the difference?
hints: Start at 64°F and count up until 72°F. The number of degrees counted is the difference.
Eight degrees separate 64°F and 72°F. You can calculate 72 − 64 = 8.

screens.label: Reflect
screens.title: What does difference mean?
screens.prompt: Choose the statement that explains the idea.

choices.text: Difference is the number left after two groups are paired.
choices.feedback: Correct. The number left after pairing tells how far apart the two groups are.

choices.text: Difference means add the amounts together.

hints: Pair the blocks one for one. The highlighted blocks are left without partners.
Count the highlighted blocks. That number is called the difference.

screens.title: You found the difference.
screens.body: You connected comparison language, the visual gap, and subtraction.
screens.nextRecommendation: Next: use the difference when the compared amount is unknown.
